offsite.title: Offsite backups (restic)
offsite.desc: Incremental deduplicated copy to a remote repository (S3, SFTP, REST server, or mounted folder) after each backup.
offsite.envHint: Format KEY=value, one per line (e.g. AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID). Leave blank to keep existing.
offsite.serverToggleHint: Automatically sends manual and scheduled backups to the restic repository.
offsite.notConfiguredHint: Configure the restic repository in global Settings first.
offsite.noSnapshots: No remote snapshots for this server.
offsite.restoreConfirm: The server will be stopped, the world and configs replaced with snapshot {id}, then the server will be restarted. Continue?
